oneSentenceConcept: The hero becomes a restrained cinematic control surface where typography, state rails, and tactile hover cues make the portfolio feel like a transparent AI-native system without changing content.
heroConcept: A dark full-bleed hero stages oversized type beside luminous status rails and artifact-like panels. Scroll advances the rails in calm beats while pointer hover exposes contained depth.
emergingSignals: Scrollytelling as controlled sequence rather than page hopping
Protocol-native AI interfaces exposing state, tools, and artifacts
Tactile product interactions through stop-motion, hover detail, and 3D object cues
Shader and WebGL atmosphere used as a restrained material layer
No-code motion tooling normalizing GSAP-grade text and scroll choreography
visualLanguage: Luxury-tech restraint: deep ink surfaces, off-white typography, mint signal accents, and panelized depth that reads as system intelligence rather than decoration.
interactionLanguage: Default navigation remains stable while the hero behaves like a visible state stream: scroll progresses staged rails, hover reveals artifact depth, and focus states stay immediate.
motionLanguage: Subtle cinematic pacing with directional crossfades, rail progression, and soft depth reveals. Motion communicates continuity and system state, never spectacle.
storytellingApproach: The hero acts as a live prologue; supporting sections inherit a chapter-scroll rhythm with calm reveals and clear reading order.
creativeTechnologyIdeas: AG-UI-inspired state rail metaphors for hero progress indicators
Single lightweight shader or noise plane as atmospheric backdrop with static fallback
CSS scroll-driven animation for rail progress and type cadence
Structured artifact panels that imply generated outputs without changing site data
typographyDirection: Bold sans display with compressed-to-expanded tension in the hero; body text stays minimal, high-contrast, and steady.
compositionDirection: Split-grid hero with type on one axis and luminous system rails on the other; supporting sections use disciplined grids and quiet panel rhythm.
colorDirection: Deep ink background, warm off-white foreground, mint signal accent, and blue-gray support surfaces for a premium AI-native atmosphere.
textureDirection: Low-noise shader haze, thin borders, and glass-safe panel depth; texture should feel like a readable interface layer, not a decorative fog.
supportingPageTreatment: Cards become restrained artifacts with glass-safe surfaces, subtle elevation, and mint affordance accents; navigation receives only a stable accent underline.
avoid: Opaque agent metaphors that look like generic chat UI
Full-screen WebGL scenes that obscure reading
Cursor followers that compete with navigation
Autoplay loops or flashing status effects
